name: Almanac
description: A scheduled program: each morning it writes a dated note under the almanac page, wherever that is, as ext:almanac.

page.description: The page it writes under (default almanac)

outline.description: Another outline on the same host to write in (default the one it runs for)

actions.label: Write today's almanac
actions.description: Writes today's dated note under the almanac page (once a day; again says it's there)
